vignette: My husband suddenly collapsed to the floor and is not responding. He is gasping for air and his lips are turning blue.
clinical_rationale: Requires immediate life-saving intervention. Unresponsive with agonal breathing and cyanosis.

vignette: My daughter ate a peanut cookie and now she cannot breathe, her throat is closing up, face is swollen and she is wheezing loudly.
clinical_rationale: Anaphylaxis with acute airway compromise. Immediate epinephrine and intubation risk.

vignette: Patient was found completely unconscious with shallow breathing and a deep bleeding arterial wound on his neck that won't stop bleeding.
clinical_rationale: Severe exsanguination and airway threat. Immediate resuscitation required.

vignette: He has been having a continuous generalized tonic-clonic seizure for over eight minutes without waking up and is now gasping.
clinical_rationale: Status epilepticus. Immediate pharmacological termination and airway protection required.

vignette: My roommate is slumped on the couch, completely non-responsive, with pinpoint pupils and breathing only three times a minute after suspected drug overdose.
clinical_rationale: Acute opioid overdose with severe respiratory arrest. Immediate bag-valve mask and naloxone.

vignette: Construction worker caught in industrial machinery with complete traumatic amputation of the right leg above knee and massive spurting hemorrhage.
clinical_rationale: Traumatic amputation with exsanguinating shock. Immediate tourniquet and blood transfusion protocol.

vignette: Patient brought in after near drowning at the community pool, pulseless and non-breathing, CPR in progress by bystanders.
clinical_rationale: Cardiac arrest secondary to submersion. Immediate advanced life support resuscitation.

vignette: Severe gunshot wound to the right hemithorax with absent breath sounds on the right, tracheal deviation to the left, and profound hypotension.
clinical_rationale: Tension pneumothorax with obstructive shock. Immediate needle decompression and chest tube.

vignette: Diabetic patient found unresponsive in bed with glucometer reading unmeasurably low, diaphoretic, seizing, and unresponsive to painful stimuli.
clinical_rationale: Severe hypoglycemic coma with status seizure. Immediate intravenous hypertonic dextrose.

vignette: Patient pulled from burning house with third-degree circumferential burns over 60 percent of body surface area, soot in oropharynx, and severe inspiratory stridor.
clinical_rationale: Severe thermal inhalation injury with imminent complete airway closure. Immediate endotracheal intubation.

vignette: Patient presenting with massive hematemesis, vomiting two liters of bright red blood in triage, blood pressure 60/40, pulse 140, rapidly losing consciousness.
clinical_rationale: Hemorrhagic shock secondary to ruptured esophageal varices or massive peptic bleed. Immediate massive transfusion protocol.

vignette: Patient choking on a piece of steak at dinner, holding hands to throat, making silent gasping attempts, unable to speak, cough, or breathe, and turning pale blue.
clinical_rationale: Complete foreign body airway obstruction with imminent hypoxic arrest. Immediate Heimlich / airway intervention.

vignette: Pediatric patient found submerged in bathtub for unknown duration, cyanotic, flaccid, apnea with heart rate 40 beats per minute.
clinical_rationale: Pediatric severe hypoxic bradycardia / arrest. Immediate bag-mask ventilation, compressions, resuscitation.

vignette: Elderly patient found on floor after carbon monoxide leak, unarousable with decerebrate posturing and profound respiratory depression.
clinical_rationale: Severe neurotoxic carbon monoxide poisoning with coma. Immediate 100% FiO2 intubation and hyperbaric referral.

vignette: Trauma patient ejected from vehicle rollover at high speed, non-responsive with flail chest, paradoxical respirations, and barely palpable carotid pulse.
clinical_rationale: Severe polytrauma with acute respiratory collapse and shock. Immediate trauma resuscitation.

vignette: I am having severe crushing chest pain that feels like an elephant sitting on my chest, with radiating pain down my left arm and cold sweat.
clinical_rationale: High-risk acute coronary syndrome (ACS / STEMI). Immediate EKG and cardiac care pathway.

vignette: My mother suddenly developed slurred speech twenty minutes ago and has weakness and numbness on the right side of her body and face.
clinical_rationale: Acute ischemic stroke symptoms within thrombolytic time window. High-risk time-critical emergency.

vignette: I have the sudden severe worst headache of my life that came on like a thunderclap, along with a stiff neck and vomiting.
clinical_rationale: Classic thunderclap headache concerning for subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) or acute meningitis.

vignette: I started vomiting large amounts of dark red blood and blood clots about an hour ago and I feel very dizzy and faint when standing.
clinical_rationale: Severe upper gastrointestinal bleeding with orthostatic hemodynamic instability. High risk.

vignette: I have severe 10/10 tearing abdominal and back pain that started abruptly, and my abdomen feels hard as a rock.
clinical_rationale: Acute surgical abdomen / aortic dissection / ruptured viscous. High risk.

vignette: Patient states: I took a large overdose of sleeping pills and blood pressure pills two hours ago and I feel completely hopeless.
clinical_rationale: Acute high-lethality toxic ingestion with suicidal intent. High risk for rapid decompensation.

vignette: I was struck in the head with a baseball bat, lost consciousness for five minutes, and now I have clear fluid leaking from my nose and confusion.
clinical_rationale: Severe traumatic brain injury with basilar skull fracture sign and post-traumatic confusion.

vignette: 26F who is 8 weeks pregnant presents with sudden severe sharp right lower quadrant pelvic pain, vaginal spotting, and syncope.
clinical_rationale: Ruptured ectopic pregnancy with intra-abdominal hemorrhage. High-risk surgical emergency.

vignette: Known asthmatic presents with acute severe breathlessness, unable to speak more than one word at a time, using sternocleidomastoid accessory muscles.
clinical_rationale: Severe status asthmaticus with impending respiratory fatigue. High risk for intubation.

vignette: 16M presents with sudden onset of severe excruciating right testicular pain and swelling that began 90 minutes ago, accompanied by nausea.
clinical_rationale: Acute testicular torsion. Time-critical organ-loss emergency requiring immediate surgical exploration.

vignette: 52F presents with severe sudden ocular pain, rainbow halos around lights, cloudy steamy cornea, fixed mid-dilated pupil, and severe nausea.
clinical_rationale: Acute angle-closure glaucoma. High risk for permanent irreversible vision loss.

vignette: Cancer patient undergoing active chemotherapy presents with high fever of 103.5F, rigors, heart rate 125, and feeling dizzy.
clinical_rationale: Febrile neutropenia / septic shock risk. Immediate broad-spectrum IV antibiotics within 60 minutes.

vignette: 34F with history of deep vein thrombosis presents with sudden sharp pleuritic chest pain, coughing up blood, acute dyspnea, and tachycardia of 130.
clinical_rationale: Acute pulmonary embolism with pulmonary infarction signs. High risk.

vignette: Industrial laboratory worker had concentrated sodium hydroxide alkali chemical splashed directly into both eyes five minutes ago, experiencing blinding pain.
clinical_rationale: Ocular chemical burn (alkali liquefactive necrosis). Immediate continuous eye irrigation.

vignette: Patient with known Type 1 diabetes presents with deep rapid Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath odor, persistent vomiting, and confusion.
clinical_rationale: Severe diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) with metabolic acidosis and altered mental status.

vignette: 42M presents with sudden painless loss of vision in the left eye described as a dark curtain descending over his visual field.
clinical_rationale: Acute retinal detachment / central retinal artery occlusion. High risk time-critical ophthalmic emergency.

vignette: Patient on high-dose Warfarin anticoagulation therapy presents with massive spontaneous epistaxis filling cups with blood that will not stop bleeding.
clinical_rationale: Uncontrolled coagulopathic posterior hemorrhage with airway compromise risk.

vignette: Young adult brought in by family after sending goodbye messages, found sitting with a loaded firearm and expressing active desire to end their life.
clinical_rationale: Acute high-acuity behavioral emergency with imminent lethal threat. Requires 1-to-1 safety observation.

vignette: 60M with chronic aortic aneurysm presents with tearing mid-scapular interscapular back pain, asymmetric blood pressure between arms, and diaphoresis.
clinical_rationale: Acute aortic dissection (Stanford Type A/B). Catastrophic vascular emergency.

vignette: Patient with neck swelling after dental extraction has severe difficulty swallowing, drooling, muffled hot-potato voice, and anterior neck erythema.
clinical_rationale: Ludwig's angina / submandibular deep neck space infection with imminent airway compromise.

vignette: I have had moderate crampy right lower quadrant abdominal pain for 12 hours with mild nausea and low-grade temperature of 99.8F.
clinical_rationale: Requires multiple resources (CT scan, blood lab panel, IV fluids) to rule out appendicitis, but hemodynamically stable.

vignette: I slipped on ice and hurt my left wrist. It is painful and swollen, but my fingers are warm and pink with normal sensation.
clinical_rationale: Requires X-ray, splinting, and analgesics (2 resources). Stable vital signs, no neurovascular compromise.

vignette: I have had a productive cough with yellowish phlegm and feeling feverish for 3 days. My oxygen level on my home meter is 96 percent.
clinical_rationale: Suspected pneumonia or bronchitis requiring chest X-ray and lab work, but breathing is comfortable and vitals stable.

vignette: I have had burning pain when urinating along with dull right lower back ache for two days. No vomiting and no high fever.
clinical_rationale: Possible pyelonephritis or complicated UTI requiring urinalysis, urine culture, and oral/IV antibiotics.

vignette: 48F presents with colicky right upper quadrant abdominal pain that radiates to right shoulder blade after eating fried chicken 3 hours ago, accompanied by nausea.
clinical_rationale: Biliary colic / acute cholecystitis requiring abdominal ultrasound, IV antiemetics, and labs.

vignette: 55M presents with acute left flank pain radiating to left groin with gross hematuria, pacing the room in discomfort, vital signs normal.
clinical_rationale: Acute nephrolithiasis (renal colic) requiring non-contrast CT, IV analgesia, and urinalysis.

vignette: 62M presents with persistent left lower quadrant pain and constipation for 4 days, low-grade temperature 100.2F, no peritoneal signs.
clinical_rationale: Acute uncomplicated diverticulitis requiring CT scan of abdomen/pelvis, labs, and IV hydration.

vignette: 38F presents with 3 days of unilateral right calf pain and swelling after an 8-hour airplane flight, unable to comfortably bear weight.
clinical_rationale: Suspected deep vein thrombosis (DVT) requiring compression duplex ultrasound and D-dimer lab.

vignette: Patient with history of moderate asthma has worsening wheezing and chest tightness after catching a cold, oxygen saturation 95% on room air.
clinical_rationale: Moderate asthma exacerbation requiring nebulized bronchodilators, systemic corticosteroids, and peak flow.

vignette: 70M presents with acute painful urinary retention, unable to void for 10 hours, suprapubic fullness and moderate distress.
clinical_rationale: Acute urinary retention requiring bladder catheterization, post-void residual, and renal function panel.

vignette: 29M presents with worsening painful swelling and redness on his right buttock for 3 days, fluctuant 4cm tender mass, temperature 99.1F.
clinical_rationale: Cutaneous abscess requiring incision and drainage, local anesthesia, and wound packing.

vignette: Patient presents with persistent vomiting and diarrhea for 24 hours from viral gastroenteritis, feeling dizzy when standing, pulse 98, BP 110/70.
clinical_rationale: Moderate volume depletion requiring IV fluid hydration, IV antiemetics, and basic electrolyte panel.

vignette: Patient with established chronic sickle cell disease presents with typical moderate vaso-occlusive bone pain in bilateral humeri and thighs, baseline vitals.
clinical_rationale: Sickle cell vaso-occlusive pain crisis requiring IV opioid analgesia, IV hydration, and CBC/reticulocyte count.

vignette: 65F presents with sudden onset of room-spinning vertigo that worsens when turning head to left, with nausea and horizontal nystagmus, normal gait.
clinical_rationale: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) or vestibular neuritis requiring Dix-Hallpike, Epley maneuver, and vestibular suppressants.

vignette: 50M presents with expanding area of warmth, erythema, and tenderness on left anterior shin for 2 days without bullae or systemic signs.
clinical_rationale: Lower extremity cellulitis requiring initial IV antibiotic loading dose, blood labs, and skin marking.

vignette: I accidentally cut my left thumb with a clean kitchen knife while slicing bread. The bleeding stopped after direct pressure, but the cut is open about 1.5 cm.
clinical_rationale: Single resource needed (sutures or simple wound closure). Normal vital signs.

vignette: I twisted my ankle playing basketball yesterday. It is mildly swollen on the outer ankle, but I am able to put weight on it and walk.
clinical_rationale: Requires single resource (ankle X-ray or physical assessment). No acute deformity.

vignette: My right eye has been itchy, pink, and watery for two days with clear drainage. My vision is completely normal and I have no eye pain.
clinical_rationale: Likely viral conjunctivitis. Single resource (prescription eye drops / exam).

vignette: I have an itchy red localized rash on my right forearm after gardening near poison ivy. No facial swelling, no breathing problems.
clinical_rationale: Contact dermatitis requiring single resource (topical corticosteroid ointment).

vignette: I have had a mild sore throat, clear runny nose, and sneezing for two days. No difficulty swallowing and no fever.
clinical_rationale: Upper respiratory viral illness. Single resource (throat culture or symptomatic prescription).

vignette: 24F presents with dysuria and increased urinary frequency for 24 hours, afebrile, no back or flank pain, denies nausea.
clinical_rationale: Uncomplicated acute cystitis requiring single resource (point-of-care urinalysis and oral antibiotics).

vignette: 7-year-old child with acute left earache that began last night, pulling at ear, mild fever 99.5F, alert and playful in triage.
clinical_rationale: Acute otitis media requiring single resource (otoscopic exam and oral amoxicillin prescription).

vignette: Carpenter got a wooden splinter embedded deep under the fingernail of his index finger 3 hours ago, unable to extract at home.
clinical_rationale: Subungual foreign body requiring single resource (simple digital block and splinter removal).

vignette: Patient presents with painful red swelling beside the cuticle of right thumb for 2 days after hangnail trimming, small white pustule visible.
clinical_rationale: Acute paronychia requiring single resource (simple scalpel drainage under digital block).

vignette: Gardener scratched cornea on a rose bush branch 4 hours ago, foreign body sensation and photophobia, visual acuity 20/25.
clinical_rationale: Corneal abrasion requiring single resource (fluorescein stain examination and erythromycin ointment).

vignette: Patient jammed left middle finger catching a basketball, mildly swollen proximal interphalangeal joint, good range of motion, no skin break.
clinical_rationale: Finger sprain requiring single resource (2-view finger X-ray and buddy taping).

vignette: Adult presents with superficial second-degree burn the size of a quarter on forearm after hot soup splash, small intact blister.
clinical_rationale: Minor superficial partial-thickness burn requiring single resource (cleansing, bacitracin, dressing).

vignette: Patient presents with painful swelling in mouth under tongue after meals, small firm movable white calculus visible at submandibular duct.
clinical_rationale: Sialolithiasis (salivary duct stone) requiring single resource (intraoral palpation, sialogogues).

vignette: I ran out of my monthly blood pressure and cholesterol medications yesterday and need a routine refill prescription from a doctor. Feeling completely fine.
clinical_rationale: Zero hospital resources required. Routine outpatient medication refill.

vignette: I had five stitches put in my forearm ten days ago at urgent care. The wound is completely healed and I am here to have the sutures removed.
clinical_rationale: Zero hospital resources required. Suture removal only.

vignette: I have a small dry patch of skin on my right elbow that has been slightly itchy for over a month. No pain, no bleeding, no fever.
clinical_rationale: Chronic mild dermatological condition. Zero acute emergency resources.

vignette: I need a routine pre-employment physical exam and medical clearance form signed for my new job.
clinical_rationale: Administrative medical examination. Zero emergency resources.

vignette: I have had mild lower back stiffness in the mornings for several months that improves with gentle stretching. No numbness, weakness, or leg pain.
clinical_rationale: Chronic mechanical back stiffness without red flags. Outpatient physical therapy referral.

vignette: Patient presents asking for an update to their tetanus vaccination after cleaning up yard waste, no cuts, punctures, or wounds present.
clinical_rationale: Routine preventative immunization. Zero diagnostic emergency resources.

vignette: Patient noticed an engorged tick on their pant leg after walking in woods today, tick was brushed off, no bite mark, no rash, completely asymptomatic.
clinical_rationale: Asymptomatic tick exposure without bite. Reassurance and education.

vignette: Patient presents asking for doctor's sick leave note for employer after missing work yesterday due to mild hangover, currently asymptomatic.
clinical_rationale: Administrative medical certification. Zero clinical emergency resources.

vignette: Patient presents with long-standing mild toe fungus on two toenails for six months, asking what over-the-counter polish to use.
clinical_rationale: Chronic onychomycosis. Routine outpatient counseling, zero emergency resources.

vignette: Patient requests clean sterile gauze and medical tape to re-wrap a clean healing superficial scratch on forearm.
clinical_rationale: Routine dressing change request. Zero emergency physician resources.

vignette: College student requests routine tuberculosis PPD skin test reading 48 hours after placement, forearm is completely flat with zero induration.
clinical_rationale: Routine negative PPD test reading. Zero emergency resources.

vignette: Patient requesting blood pressure check on their way to the pharmacy, states they feel fine and their home machine showed 124/82.
clinical_rationale: Isolated asymptomatic screening. Normal blood pressure, zero emergency interventions.

vignette: 45-year-old male was found in garage with car running, completely unresponsive with cherry-red skin, gasping agonal respirations, and unmeasurable SpO2.
clinical_rationale: Severe carbon monoxide poisoning with anoxic brain injury and impending arrest.

vignette: 12-year-old boy stung by multiple bees at camp, collapsed in anaphylactic shock, audible inspiratory stridor, profound cyanosis, and impalpable radial pulses.
clinical_rationale: Severe refractory anaphylactic shock with acute upper airway closure.

vignette: Pediatric toddler seized continuously for 20 minutes at daycare, remains flaccid and unresponsive with shallow irregular breathing and cyanotic extremities.
clinical_rationale: Status epilepticus with post-ictal respiratory failure.

vignette: Construction worker fell four stories, non-responsive, massive open cranial vault trauma with exposed brain matter and agonal breathing.
clinical_rationale: Catastrophic open traumatic brain injury requiring immediate resuscitation.

vignette: Elderly female with history of heart failure collapsed in church, pulseless, bystander CPR initiated with automated external defibrillator advising shock.
clinical_rationale: Out-of-hospital ventricular fibrillation cardiac arrest.

vignette: Patient with known severe depression ingested an entire bottle of potassium chloride and tricyclic antidepressants, unresponsive with widening QRS on monitor and severe hypotension.
clinical_rationale: Severe life-threatening cardiotoxic overdose with malignant dysrhythmia.

vignette: Motorcycle crash victim with complete traumatic transection of femoral artery, blood pooling rapidly on stretcher, systolic BP 55 mmHg, pulse 150.
clinical_rationale: Exsanguinating hemorrhagic shock from major vascular trauma.

vignette: Child swallowed a coin, completely unable to cough or breathe, making silent clutching gestures at neck and turning dark purple.
clinical_rationale: Acute complete upper airway obstruction requiring immediate foreign body airway clearance.

vignette: Patient with end-stage renal disease missed dialysis for two weeks, found unresponsive with profound bradycardia of 22 bpm and peaked T waves on rhythm strip.
clinical_rationale: Severe hyperkalemic cardiac arrest peri-arrest emergency.

vignette: Swimmer pulled from ocean surf, apneic and pulseless with frothy pink sputum emerging from mouth and nose.
clinical_rationale: Submersion drowning arrest with acute pulmonary edema.

vignette: Industrial burn victim with high-voltage electrical contact, entrance and exit wounds, entry into sustained ventricular tachycardia with loss of consciousness.
clinical_rationale: Electrical cardiac arrest with high-voltage conduction disturbance.

vignette: Severe motor vehicle collision victim with bilateral open tension pneumothoraces, massive subcutaneous emphysema, absent bilateral breath sounds, and unmeasurable BP.
clinical_rationale: Bilateral tension pneumothorax causing acute obstructive arrest.

vignette: 64-year-old male with diabetes reports sudden heavy crushing retrosternal chest tightness, feeling dizzy, and profuse diaphoresis that started 40 minutes ago.
clinical_rationale: Acute coronary syndrome (STEMI / NSTEMI) in high-risk diabetic patient.

vignette: 58-year-old female presents with acute onset of right facial droop, right arm paralysis, and inability to speak coherent words starting 35 minutes ago.
clinical_rationale: Acute acute ischemic stroke within thrombolytic/endovascular window.

vignette: 31-year-old female presents with sudden explosive worst headache of her life accompanied by neck stiffness, photophobia, and projectile vomiting.
clinical_rationale: Spontaneous subarachnoid hemorrhage from ruptured intracranial aneurysm.

vignette: 72-year-old male on Eliquis anticoagulation therapy presents with massive coughing up of bright red blood, filled two emesis basins, feeling lightheaded.
clinical_rationale: Massive hemoptysis with risk of asphyxiation and hemorrhagic shock.

vignette: 24-year-old female with positive home pregnancy test has sudden severe agonizing lower abdominal pain, shoulder pain, and passed out in the bathroom.
clinical_rationale: Ruptured ectopic pregnancy with acute hemoperitoneum.

vignette: 19-year-old male reports acute onset of excruciating left scrotal pain 2 hours ago with swelling, nausea, and absent cremasteric reflex.
clinical_rationale: Acute testicular torsion requiring surgical detorsion within 6 hours.

vignette: 61-year-old male with chronic hypertension has severe tearing substernal chest pain radiating between shoulder blades with blood pressure 210/115 in right arm and 140/85 in left arm.
clinical_rationale: Acute aortic dissection (Stanford Type A/B).

vignette: 45-year-old female presents with acute severe eye pain, halos around lights, cloudy cornea, fixed dilated pupil, and severe frontal headache.
clinical_rationale: Acute angle-closure glaucoma with impending irreversible blindness.

vignette: Chemotherapy patient for lymphoma has fever of 103.8F, shaking rigors, heart rate 130 bpm, blood pressure 85/50, and extreme fatigue.
clinical_rationale: Neutropenic sepsis / septic shock.

vignette: Young adult brought in by police after texting family a suicide note, found sitting on a bridge with intent to jump and expressing active hopelessness.
clinical_rationale: Severe acute suicidal crisis requiring continuous 1:1 psychiatric safety supervision.

vignette: Industrial worker splashed concentrated battery acid into both eyes 10 minutes ago, severe chemosis, extreme blepharospasm, and screaming in pain.
clinical_rationale: Acute ocular chemical burn requiring immediate emergency eye irrigation.

vignette: Patient with known Type 1 diabetes has fruity acetone breath, deep rapid Kussmaul respirations, glucose 650 mg/dL, and extreme lethargy.
clinical_rationale: Severe diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) with metabolic acidosis.

vignette: 35-year-old female with sudden shortness of breath, pleuritic chest pain, heart rate 128 bpm, and unilateral left lower leg swelling following recent oral contraceptive use.
clinical_rationale: Acute pulmonary embolism with signs of right ventricular strain.

vignette: 48-year-old male presents with severe progressive difficulty swallowing, inability to manage secretions, muffled voice, and bilateral submandibular woody induration.
clinical_rationale: Ludwig's angina with acute threat to airway patency.

vignette: Child with high fever, barking seal-like cough, significant inspiratory stridor at rest, and sternal retractions.
clinical_rationale: Severe laryngotracheobronchitis (croup) with impending upper airway compromise.

vignette: Patient stabbed in left anterior chest, small puncture wound near 4th intercostal space, muffled heart sounds, distended neck veins, and hypotension.
clinical_rationale: Beck's triad concerning for acute cardiac tamponade.

vignette: Known asthmatic presents in triage sitting upright in tripod position, diaphoresis, unable to speak, with absent breath sounds on auscultation (silent chest).
clinical_rationale: Near-fatal status asthmaticus with severe airflow limitation.

vignette: Elderly patient with acute severe 10/10 abdominal pain out of proportion to exam findings, history of atrial fibrillation, and bloody diarrhea.
clinical_rationale: Acute mesenteric ischemia requiring urgent surgical exploration.

vignette: Young adult took intentional overdose of 50 tablets of Tylenol extra strength 4 hours ago, accompanied by persistent nausea and diaphoresis.
clinical_rationale: Acute toxic acetaminophen ingestion requiring emergency N-acetylcysteine protocol.

vignette: Patient with skull fracture from assault now has ipsilateral dilated fixed pupil, contralateral hemiparesis, and declining Glasgow Coma Scale.
clinical_rationale: Acute epidural hematoma with uncal herniation syndrome.

vignette: Patient with deep soft tissue infection on perineum with rapid spread, severe pain out of proportion, purple bullae, and subcutaneous crepitus.
clinical_rationale: Fournier's gangrene / necrotizing soft tissue infection.

vignette: 70-year-old male with sudden onset of complete paraplegia and urinary retention over 2 hours, loss of sensation from navel down.
clinical_rationale: Acute spinal cord compression / anterior spinal artery syndrome.

vignette: 40-year-old female with history of Grave's disease presents with hyperpyrexia 105F, extreme tachycardia 160 bpm, delirium, and agitation.
clinical_rationale: Thyroid storm / severe thyrotoxic crisis.

vignette: Patient with heat stroke during marathon collapsed with core body temperature 106.2F, anhidrotic hot dry skin, and profound confusion.
clinical_rationale: Exertional heat stroke with acute encephalopathy.

vignette: 30-year-old female presents with sudden thunderclap onset of painless, total vision loss in the right eye like a shade pulled down.
clinical_rationale: Central retinal artery occlusion (stroke of the eye).

vignette: Child with high fever, sore throat, drooling, leaning forward in tripod posture, refusing to open mouth or lie down.
clinical_rationale: Acute epiglottitis with imminent respiratory arrest risk.

vignette: Patient with known hemophilia A presents with spontaneous massive tense swelling and excruciating pain in right thigh following minor bump.
clinical_rationale: Massive internal hemophilic hemarthrosis / compartment syndrome risk.

vignette: Young female presents with severe generalized petechial purpuric rash, high fever 104F, confusion, and nuchal rigidity.
clinical_rationale: Acute meningococcemia with purpura fulminans.

vignette: 22-year-old male presents with crampy periumbilical pain that migrated to right lower quadrant over 14 hours, nausea, low-grade temperature 100.1F.
clinical_rationale: Suspected acute appendicitis requiring CT scan, blood labs, and IV fluids.

vignette: 54-year-old female presents with postprandial right upper quadrant pain radiating to scapula after fatty meal, nausea, afebrile.
clinical_rationale: Biliary colic / acute cholecystitis requiring ultrasound and labs.

vignette: 43-year-old male presents with severe spasmodic left flank pain radiating to groin with microscopic hematuria, restless but normal vitals.
clinical_rationale: Acute nephrolithiasis (renal stone) requiring CT KUB and IV pain control.

vignette: 36-year-old female presents with dysuria, urinary frequency, fever 101.5F, and moderate right costovertebral angle tenderness.
clinical_rationale: Acute pyelonephritis requiring urine culture, labs, and IV antibiotics.

vignette: 60-year-old male with COPD has increased yellow sputum production and moderate breathlessness for 3 days, oxygen saturation 93% on room air.
clinical_rationale: COPD exacerbation requiring chest X-ray, nebulizers, and oral steroids.

vignette: 27-year-old female slipped and sustained closed left wrist deformity with moderate swelling and pain, radial pulse 2+, sensation intact.
clinical_rationale: Colles wrist fracture requiring 3-view X-ray, hematoma block, reduction and splint.

vignette: 49-year-old male presents with localized left lower quadrant pain and obstipation for 3 days, low-grade temp 100.0F, soft abdomen.
clinical_rationale: Acute diverticulitis requiring abdominal CT and oral/IV antibiotics.

vignette: 68-year-old male with benign prostatic hyperplasia has painful urinary retention, unable to void for 8 hours, palpable bladder.
clinical_rationale: Acute urinary retention requiring Foley catheterization and renal panel.

vignette: 32-year-old female with unilateral painful right calf swelling for 4 days after long travel, no chest pain or dyspnea.
clinical_rationale: Suspected deep vein thrombosis requiring venous duplex ultrasound.

vignette: 25-year-old male with tender fluctuant 3cm abscess on upper back for 4 days, mild surrounding erythema, no fever.
clinical_rationale: Cutaneous abscess requiring incision, drainage, and packing.

vignette: 18-year-old male with sickle cell disease has typical vaso-occlusive pain in lower back and legs for 12 hours, afebrile, baseline vitals.
clinical_rationale: Uncomplicated sickle cell pain crisis requiring IV hydration and analgesia.

vignette: 55-year-old female presents with sudden episodic spinning room vertigo on head movement with nausea, normal gait, no hearing loss.
clinical_rationale: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo requiring physical repositioning maneuvers.

vignette: 39-year-old male presents with 2 days of productive cough with rust-colored sputum, fever 101.2F, localized crackles, SpO2 95%.
clinical_rationale: Community-acquired lobar pneumonia requiring chest radiograph, blood work, antibiotics.

vignette: 45-year-old male presents with spreading warm tender red erythema over left leg for 3 days, temperature 99.8F, no purulence.
clinical_rationale: Lower extremity cellulitis requiring blood labs and IV/oral antibiotic therapy.

vignette: 50-year-old female with history of migraine reports severe throbbing unilateral headache with nausea for 2 days, similar to past migraines.
clinical_rationale: Status migrainosus requiring IV antimigraine cocktail and hydration.

vignette: 29-year-old female with known Crohn's disease presents with moderate crampy abdominal pain and 5 episodes of non-bloody diarrhea.
clinical_rationale: Crohn's flare requiring inflammatory markers, hydration, and gastroenterology consult.

vignette: 40-year-old male with acute gout flare in right first metatarsophalangeal joint, severe swelling, redness, unable to bear weight.
clinical_rationale: Acute gouty arthritis requiring joint examination, uric acid, and indomethacin.

vignette: 33-year-old female presents with acute pelvic pain and purulent cervical discharge for 4 days, low-grade temperature 100.2F.
clinical_rationale: Pelvic inflammatory disease requiring pelvic ultrasound, cultures, and dual antibiotic therapy.

vignette: 63-year-old male presents with painless jaundice and dark tea-colored urine for 2 weeks, normal vital signs.
clinical_rationale: Obstructive biliary jaundice requiring comprehensive liver panel, bilirubin, and abdominal ultrasound.

vignette: 21-year-old college student with severe sore throat, fever 101F, bilateral cervical lymphadenopathy, and splenomegaly.
clinical_rationale: Infectious mononucleosis requiring Monospot test, CBC, and airway evaluation.

vignette: 20-year-old male presents with clean 2 cm laceration on palm from broken drinking glass, bleeding stopped with pressure, full tendon function.
clinical_rationale: Simple laceration requiring single resource (local anesthesia and simple sutures).

vignette: 17-year-old female inverted ankle playing volleyball, moderate lateral swelling, able to walk 4 steps, tenderness at anterior talofibular ligament.
clinical_rationale: Ankle sprain requiring single resource (2-view ankle radiograph).

vignette: 28-year-old female presents with burning urination and frequency for 24 hours, afebrile, denies flank pain or vaginal discharge.
clinical_rationale: Uncomplicated lower urinary tract infection requiring point-of-care urinalysis and oral antibiotic.

vignette: 5-year-old child presents with 2 days of right ear tugging and irritability, otoscopy shows bulging erythematous tympanic membrane.
clinical_rationale: Acute otitis media requiring single resource (otoscopy and oral amoxicillin prescription).

vignette: 35-year-old male presents with itchy watery bilateral red eyes with crusting in mornings, vision 20/20, pupils equal and reactive.
